title: An imported work order of a flagged customer is internal
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Have a work order import file for this test with one work order for customer A on asset 1.
custom_steps:
1. Import the file through the work order import.
  2. Open the imported work order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The import finishes with one work order for customer A on asset 1.

Step 2:

  • The work order shows the "Internal" badge.
  • Its menu offers no "Convert to No Charge".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-E3: “An imported work order takes the classification of its customer at import: internal for a flagged customer while the setting is on, billable otherwise. No Charge is never imported; the advisor can convert it as in S2-R5.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
